summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 'Sample Peek' section on the landing page (/). Verified rendering & all data-testids, dot navigation, auto-cycle, CTA navigation to /storybook/narrator-demo-01 with Read Aloud button, mobile 375px responsiveness, Bahasa Indonesia i18n copy, and graceful fallback when /api/stories/narrator-demo-01 returns 404. All 7 requested scenarios passed. No console errors. Only minor design/a11y nits found.

issues: Dot navigation buttons are only 8x8px (measured bounding box on both desktop and mobile) - below the WCAG 2.5.8 24x24px minimum target size; hard to tap on mobile. Suggest wrapping in a larger padded hit area.

Auto-cycle interval is not reset when the user manually clicks a dot (useEffect depends only on [story]), so a manual selection can be overridden shortly after the click. Observed stable in one run, but timing-dependent; also no pause-on-hover/interaction.
No prefers-reduced-motion handling for the samplePreviewIn animation, the rotated card, and the 4.2s auto-cycle.
Illustration swap on cycle has no crossfade (opacity transition exists on img but src swap is instant) - can look abrupt if the second image is not yet cached.

action_items: Increase dot navigation hit area to >=24px (visual dot can stay 8px).
Reset/restart the auto-cycle interval on manual dot click and pause on hover/focus.
Optional: respect prefers-reduced-motion and preload page-2 image for a smooth swap.
critical_code_review_comments: SamplePeek auto-cycle useEffect should include idx-reset dependency or use a key to restart the timer after user interaction.
Graceful fallback is correctly implemented (returns null on fetch failure) - verified with a mocked 404; rest of the landing page stayed intact with zero error elements.
seed_data_creation: None. narrator-demo-01 was not modified or deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sample Peek verified end-to-end: testids sample-peek-section/-illustration/-preview-text/-dots/-dot-0/-dot-1/-peek-cta all present; CTA href '/storybook/narrator-demo-01' navigates and start-read-aloud-button renders; auto-cycle advances within ~4.2s; illustration src changes per page; mobile 375px stacks with no horizontal overflow (docW==375); ID locale uses uppercase CSS text-transform so eyebrow reads 'INTIP SEBENTAR' (case-insensitive match needed in assertions); language toggle testids are interface-language-en / interface-language-id inside language-panel.
